column7: Vault and Azure Key Vault connectors accepted a link-local configured Address (including cloud IMDS, 169.254.169.254) with no rejection at registration or dial time; fixed by validateConnectorAddressNotLinkLocal (registration, literal-IP case) plus connectGuardedDialer's netutil.Dialer{Disallow: netutil.IsLinkLocal} (every dial, including a hostname resolving to link-local); deliberately narrower than a full private-range block -- general RFC-1918/on-prem addresses stay unguarded, the on-prem deployment baseline; see docs/findings/2026-09-19-FINDING-connect-response-trust-gaps.md §2/§5
